text:
Nora: quick design review — thresholds matrix row. Two things: inline unit dropdown vs tiny toggle for short/verbose, and suppression preview overlaps rule label at narrow widths. Also need to show scheduled suppressions (suppress-by-schedule) visibly. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/thresholds-matrix-schedule.png

Elliot: dropdown wins for discoverability, toggle OK if we expose verbose text to ATs. For scheduled mutes show a clock icon + "Muted until 09:00 PST" on the chip so on-call knows it's temporary.

Priya: copy tweak: helper currently "when error rate > 2%" -> change to "When error rate exceeds 2% (p95, 5m)". Spell out "exceeds" not using ">". Add small info tooltip explaining p95 vs p99.

Jace: mobile: stop horizontal pill scrollers. Show first row + "+N channels" button that expands into a stacked list with role=list and aria-roledescription='notification channels'. Button needs aria-expanded + aria-controls.

a11y-bot: Contrast check: muted-chip text #6D6D6D on #FFFFFF fails AA for 14px. Recommend neutral-800 (#333333) or semibold 600 at 14px. Add focus-visible outline for pills and aria-live polite region announcing "Suppression enabled — 2 channels muted" when toggled. Keep muted chips in DOM but dim and add aria-label 'Channel X — muted until 09:00 PST'.

Elliot: Also surface routing fallbacks in preview: "Primary: Slack (latency) • Fallback: Email (on error)". Tooltip can explain fallback triggers and latency thresholds. If a fallback is suppressed show it with strikethrough + muted label.

Nora: action items: Elliot -> mocks for dropdown + toggle with sr-only verbose + scheduled mute state, Priya -> update helper copy & tooltip text, Jace -> mobile stacked prototype + aria attributes, a11y-bot -> provide exact color tokens and focus spec. Target: next design sync Monday. Thanks all :raised_hands:
